name: Josou Gyaru Bitch Gakuen ~Half Musume Judy no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 女装ギャルビッチ学園 ～ハーフ娘ジュディの誘惑～
source:
Thanks to Asuka and Miyabi, the protagonist is completely captivated by the charm of cross-dressing girls. 
He enjoys having sex with them almost every day.
One day, Miyabi invites him to visit her villa during the upcoming long weekend. 
Asuka, who he always hangs out with, introduces him to another friend—Osaki Judy, a half-American cross-dressing girl from the next class. 
She's also a cross-dresser, but she's a fashionable, busty shemale who's had breast augmentation to wear women's clothes more naturally. 
With her in tow, and her passionate, Western-style approach to the protagonist, his erotic life with Asuka and Miyabi becomes even more intense.

[From the [url=http://www.gocha-mix.com/gp/db02/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
在明日香与雅的带领下，主人公彻底迷上了女装少年的独特魅力，
几乎每天都与他们尽享鱼水之欢。
某天，雅邀请他在即将到来的小长假期间前往自家的别墅度假；
平日里总和他形影不离的明日香，还向他介绍了另一位朋友——隔壁班的美日混血伪娘大崎朱蒂。
朱蒂同样是一名女装少年，不过为了能更自然地驾驭女装，她特意做了隆胸手术，摇身一变成了时髦火辣的巨乳人妖。
随着作风大胆奔放、充满美式热情的朱蒂加入同行，主人公与明日香、雅之间的香艳日常更是愈发火热激烈。
